planets.name: TOI-837 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-837 with a 8.32-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-837 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-837. Its orbit and size follow Barragán et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
